Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the eligibility of foreign medical school graduates for licensing as physician assistants.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the eligibility of foreign medical schoolgraduates for licensing as physician assistants; and repealing RCW18.71A.045.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: RCW 18.71A.045 (Eligibility of foreignmedical school graduates) and 1994 sp.s. c 9 s 322 & 1988 c 113 s 2 areeach repealed.
